Tiers: opus 153, bind 101 (rollups + EXISTS), sonnet 58. Proof: no open question row has a served proof today; only R084.6 and R085.6 name a served test.
Key fact: every VERIFIED question row (e.g. R003.2, fan-manager, uptime) is proven by `crates/medulla-rdf/tests/connector_competency*.rs` running `medulla_rdf::sparql::execute` on hand-written Turtle. Provenance (`dc:source`, `dc:identifier`, `dc:date`) is typed into the fixture, not produced by the engine. These are L1 crate proofs, not served-path proofs.
The 28 abstention rows (R053-R066 .1/.2) in `connector_competency_c4_abstentions.rs` build an `AuthorityAudit` inside the test and assert on it. `AuthorityAudit`/`select_sources` have no caller under `src/` (grep: none), so they prove nothing about the served path.

## 3. Overlaps and duplicate authority
- `:Alert`, `:alertsOn` (R068.8, R068.12): already in `it4it_delivery-v1.ttl`; a second class in infrastructure-v1. Owner: it4it_delivery; extend it (alertSeverity, alertState, firingSince).
- `:Application` (R078.2): already declared in `service_operations-v1.ttl`. Owner: service_operations.
- R067.6 materialisation: vg:materialisationReason (virtual_graph shapes:168) and dp:materialisationReason (data_platform-v1:67) plus R038 AccelerationPolicy. One owner: data-platform-vocabulary; R067.6 asserts only the "no policy means no stored rows" test.
- 64 `.3` acceptance rows restate R067.x (fetch at query time, no copy) per connector. Collapse into one table-driven served test.
- R083 restates MEDULLA-SUPPLY-VOCAB-R003.7-.17; owner supply-chain-vocabulary.
- R084/R085 prove TYPED-PACKS R105-R107 and FEDERATED R722 again; their own acceptance rows should own it.
- Same files edited by several specs: `virtual_graph-v1.ttl` (R077 here, MEDULLA-CQ-XSRC-R001.1 authority terms), `nutrition-v1.ttl` (R081 vs MEDULLA-MEDIA-VOCAB), `orchestration-v1.ttl` (R079 vs MEDULLA-ORCH-VOCAB): parallel lanes collide.
- 20 term rows (R068.2-.5, R070.2-.4, R071.2-.6, R072.1-.3, shapes R068.1/R073.1/R074.1/R075.1/R079.1) already exist on main yet stay SPECIFIED; they need only a `// spec:` binding.

## 4. Hot paths
Served: `src/server/handlers/rdf/sparql.rs:30 handle_sparql`, `rdf/obda.rs:13 handle_sparql_virtual`, `decide/stat_decide.rs:50 handle_decide`. Never reached by any open row except R084.6 / R085.6: R001-R066 .1/.2/.3, R067, R068-R081 (registry-load unit tests only).

## 5. VERIFIED isolation
Largest VERIFIED families by crate tests only: connector_competency_vocab.rs (46 bindings, TTL term loads: reachable via schema_sources registry), c4 abstentions (28, unreachable: `AuthorityAudit` not called in src/), connector_competency.rs (11, `execute` reachable via `sparql::execute` from src/server/sparql_http/route.rs but provenance is fixture text).

## 6. Common gaps
1. No served proof / test file unnamed (.1/.2/.3, R067.x). 2. Provenance supplied by fixture, not engine. 3. Rows already satisfied on main left unbound (20). 4. Duplicate term declarations (Alert, Application, materialisation). 5. 14 rows with MISSING vocabulary can only abstain.

## 7. Decisions
- D1 Drop MISSING-vocabulary connectors (14 rows) from CQ-CONN; let pack onboarding (R085) supply their ontology. Recommended.
- D2 Collapse 64 `.3` rows into one table-driven served acceptance. Recommended.
- D3 Reuse it4it_delivery/service_operations terms instead of redeclaring. Recommended.
- D4 Serve the typed abstention: wire `audit_from` into `handle_sparql_virtual` (MEDULLA-SRC-AUTH).
